title: Bar Drop Sour Pineapple Crush 10ml Nic Salts E-Liquid
description: Bar Drop Salts Sour Pineapple Crush by Drop is a vibrant tropical beverage blend. It layers the tropical notes of ripe pineapple with the sensation of sparkling soda. The experience is complemented by a distinct sour kick on the exhale, creating a fizzy, tangy vape that is full of energy. With its 40% VG / 60% PG ratio, this e-liquid ensures the sparkling soda sensation and the sour notes are punchy and clear. Designed for MTL (Mouth-to-Lung) hardware, the salt nicotine formulation delivers a smooth inhale in 5mg, 10mg, and 20mg strengths. Bar Drop Salts are brought to you by Drop and are manufactured right here in the UK. Drop’s collections focus on fabulously fruity flavours that are achingly authentic and blend familiar favourites with unique profiles.
